spans.s: घतन घतन. See घातन under घात.

घातन or घतन, अस्, आ, अम्, killing, a mur-
derer, a killer; (अस्), m., N. of certain inhabitants of
hell; (ई), f. a kind of club; (अम्), n. striking, slaying,
killing, slaughter, immolating.
—घातन-स्थान,
अम्, n. a place of slaughter, a slaughter-house.

घात घात, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. हन्), killing;
(अस्), m. a blow, a bruise, slaying killing, murdering,
slaughter; striking, wounding, hurting, destruction;
an arrow; the product (of a sum in multiplication);
[cf. कर्म-घात and ग्राम-घात.]
—घात-
कर, अस्, ई, अम्, murderous, destructive.
—घात-
चन्द्र, अस्, m. the moon when in an inauspicious
mansion.
—घात-तिथि, इस्, f. an inauspicious lunar
day.
—घात-नक्षत्र, अम्, n. an inauspicious
Nakṣatra.
—घात-वार, अस्, m. an inauspicious day
of the week.
—घात-स्थान, अम्, n. a slaughter-
house, a place of execution.
घातयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, striking, hurting, killing.

घातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be killed, what may or
ought to be killed &c., deserving death.

घाति, इस्, m. striking, killing in general; catching
[]
or killing birds, fowling [cf. नि-घाति, घाति-पक्षिन्,
घाति-विहग]; (इस्), f. a bird-net.
—घाति-पक्षिन्,
ई, m. or घाति-विहग, अस्, m. a hawk or falcon.

घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, killing, murderous, who or what
strikes or kills, a murderer; destroying, destructive,
felonious; [cf. अन्धक-घातिन्, अमित्र-घ्˚, अर्ध-
क-घ्˚, कुमार-घ्˚, &c.]

घातुक, अस्, ई, अम्, killing, tearing asunder,
hurting, hurtful, mischievous; cruel, savage, violent,
ferocious.

घात्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be killed, proper or fit to
be killed.
